body_lead: Patna (Bihar) [India], November 4 (ANI): A meeting regarding the implementation and effective execution of the e-Cabinet system was held today at the Sankalp Auditorium located at the Lok Sewak Awas, under the chairmanship of Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary. According to the release, detailed deliberations took place during the meeting to make the state cabinet's workflow modern, transparent, technology-driven, and paperless. Additional Chief Secretary of the Cabinet Secretariat Department, Arvind Kumar Choudhary, gave detailed information regarding the e-Cabinet through a presentation.
